part2.topic: Describe a movie that you saw recently
part2.prompt:
Describe a movie that you saw recently.

You should say:
- the title of the movie and what it was about
- when and where you saw it
- who you saw it with
and explain why you enjoyed/didn't enjoy seeing this movie.
